title: Required food-service logs: the minimum set
excerpt: The SanPiN baseline covers health, temperatures, finished-product checks, receiving, cleaning, and disinfectants. HACCP adds more when you work with chains or serve children's food.

body.text: When you open a café or other establishment from scratch, a reasonable question comes up: which logs are required, and which are merely recommended? The answer depends on the product range, but the basic set is the same for everyone.

items: Raw-material receiving and incoming inspection log.
UV lamp operating log (if lamps are used).
Metal contamination control log (for production facilities).

body.title: When you need the extended set
body.text: It is useful when working with chain-store buyers, children's food, hospital deliveries, or online marketplaces. It also saves time during contractor audits as your business grows.

At WeSetup, the basic set is included in the plan for one location, while the extended set is included in plans for chains and production facilities. Changing plans does not require you to create the logs again.
